readme.excerpt: A generic HTTP/API client plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH), built as a dynamic Cordis plugin. It gives the agent one httprequest model tool for arbitrary HTTP calls — any method, custom headers, JSON or text bodies, timeouts, redirect policies, and response truncation.
